steps.title: After Deep Blue appears
steps.rule: Go to 3m south of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Go to 3m north of the centre.

steps.title: After Sickest Take-off cast starts
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LaneStart).

steps.title: After Sickest Take-off resolves
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LaneStart).

steps.title: After Awesome Splash hits you
steps.rule: Go to 4m north of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 4m south of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Go to 4m west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 4m east of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Go to 4m south-west of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 4m south-east of the centre.

steps.title: Move at 46.2s
steps.rule: Go to 4m north of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 4m south of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Go to 4m west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 4m east of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Go to 4m south of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 4m east of the centre.

steps.title: After Reverse Alley-oop resolves
steps.rule: Go to 2m south of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Stand near waymark A, 12m north of the centre.
